José Mourinho Reacts to Hansi Flick: “He’s a Great Coach”

José Mourinho had a brief response when asked about Hansi Flick, praising the Barcelona coach’s work but making it clear he had little else to say about his opponents.

By LokkeeVerse · 2 min read

Mourinho Gives Short Response on Hansi Flick

José Mourinho has praised Hansi Flick, describing the Barcelona manager as a great coach who is doing an excellent job.

When asked about Flick, Mourinho questioned why the conversation was focused on his opponents before offering a brief assessment of the German tactician.

“Why are you asking me about our opponents? What do you want me to say about Flick? He’s a great coach, he’s doing an excellent job, and that’s it. I can’t say anything more,” Mourinho said.

Mourinho Keeps His Focus on His Own Team

Mourinho’s response was brief, with the Portuguese coach declining to expand on his comments about Flick.

Rather than offering a detailed analysis of Barcelona’s manager, he acknowledged Flick’s work and ended the discussion.

The exchange highlights the measured way Mourinho approached questions about an opposing coach, keeping his comments limited to praise for Flick’s performance.

Flick Continues to Attract Attention

Hansi Flick has become a prominent figure in discussions surrounding Barcelona, and comments from rival managers are often closely followed by football fans.

Mourinho’s remarks offered a straightforward assessment: he considers Flick a great coach who is doing an excellent job.

For supporters, the short exchange provides another talking point ahead of the teams’ respective football challenges.
